This work product outlines the averarching strategy based on the target audience's requirements. It includes the what, how, who, when and where the learning will be delivered. The approach covers learning design, development, delivery, assessment, evaluation as well as understanding the technology and infrastructure needs of the program.

Consider how any new learning developed aligns with the overall direction of the organizational learning strategy, how it may inform the employee experience and where it sits within the overall employee development pathway.

A tiered system is recommended, where the learning path advances from a general understanding to more specific and job-specific learning. The aim of this approach is to guarantee relevance and customize the learning experiences to meet the distinct requirements of each person.

This work product serves as a comprehensive guide for designing and implementing a learning solution. It aims to deliver sustainable, relevant, and effective learning experiences that empower individuals to acquire the necessary skills and behaviors for success. It is used to understand the learning requirements of the target audience, including the behaviors and skills they need to acquire, beyond traditional training.

This work product is used to communicate an organization's training approach to internal and external team members and to coordinate the training work effort.
